_comment: Gate for `run.mjs --gate` (after B2). Attacks: atLeast = the weakest acceptable outcome (OPEN < STEPUP < BLOCKED). Controls: outcome = the exact expected experience (OK = never asked, FRICTION = exactly one proof then the action continued); knownFalsePositive would name a documented exception (none). SU-ATK-09 (invite burst) deliberately has no floor: invite step-up is deferred and the existing 10/min limiter stays the bound (docs/P7_TRUST_SOCIAL_FOUNDATION.md § B2, approved decision). The baseline run is ungated: every attack was OPEN there by definition.
